# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in any of my projects, please **do not open a public issue**. Email **mayankbhaskardev@gmail.com** with:

- a description of the vulnerability
- steps to reproduce it
- the affected repository and, if known, a fix suggestion

I aim to acknowledge reports within **72 hours** and will credit reporters in the fix release unless they prefer to stay anonymous.
